title: Closed-site operations under weakly etale localization
statement:
For the cartesian square obtained by a weakly etale $W\to X$ and a closed
immersion $Z\to X$, restriction to $W$ commutes with the underived closed
direct image, and the two composites of inverse images agree. These
identifications respect the unit and counit of the closed adjunction.

proof.text: Set alpha to asIso of localizationRestrictionBaseChangeMap for the flipped pullback square. The source-library theorem isIso_localizationRestrictionBaseChangeMap_of_isPullback proves invertibility. Its definition is sheafPushforwardContinuousNatTrans of pullbackMapComparison, so its component on G and T is definitionally the specified restriction map.

Let adj and adjprime be the closed pullback/direct-image adjunctions and loc and locprime the weakly etale restriction/direct-image adjunctions. Define beta inverse to be the left-adjoint isomorphism conjugate to squareLowerStarIso under adj.comp locprime and loc.comp adjprime. Apply the injective mates equivalence for locprime and loc. Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv, the inverse law of conjugateEquiv, and the source-library mateEquiv_localizationRestrictionBaseChangeMap identify the mate of beta inverse with alpha hom.

Apply Mathlib unit_mateEquiv to beta inverse and the preceding mate equality; postcompose with the local closed direct image of beta hom. Functoriality and beta inverse followed by beta hom equal identity give the displayed unit identity. Apply mateEquiv_counit to the same square; precompose with the local closed inverse image of alpha inverse. Functoriality and alpha inverse followed by alpha hom equal identity give the displayed counit identity.
